ValidationRule.description: Allow CLAS Record type to be in NAS Account Closure French Canada Queue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(OR($RecordType.DeveloperName = "CAC_SKP_Shred",$RecordType.DeveloperName = "CAC_SKP_RM",$RecordType.DeveloperName = "Case_DM")), Owner:Queue.Name = "NAS Account Closure French Canada Queue")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Must change case to CLAS -Shread,CLAS - RM or CLAS - Data Management record type before adding to the NAS Account Closure French Canada Queue
